role: CEO, OpenAI; Chairman and lead investor, Helion

description: Altman backed Helion (chairman, led $500M round) and promoted its 2028 Microsoft power deal. Helion missed its own 2021 'net electricity by 2024' target and its 2025 Polaris net-electricity goal (unmet per Dec 2025 reporting; Polaris hit 150M°C D-T fusion in Feb 2026 but no net electricity).
